itens.trecho: Nothing in this shows matters. Its one limp scene after another. Its this weird show that thinks that "awkward" scenes are enough to be funny. In Pulp fiction when two killers talk about frivolous things, just as they are about to kill someone it increases the tension, because the scene is masterfully written.

(Review only for s1) After watching the last episode of the season, I had this tingly feeling in my back of deja vu, and I spent a good fifteen minutes trying to find the source- which I found in the show “You”.
